notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA for frontend mock mode and contract tests. Not government data: every market, price, date, forecast and account in this file is invented. Never present it as real (spec P10, §31 RULE 5). Screens rendered from mocks are prototypes and must be labelled as such (CLAUDE.md §M).
scenario: A still-valid token of an account deactivated or erased within its 15-minute lifetime: the account is resolved and the request answers 401; the client refreshes (refused) and retries without the token (ADR-0042, SR-04).

body.title: Unauthorized
body.detail: The account of this token is not active.
